historical_reviews.deepseek: Cannot prove six distinct VR-zone resources or the Web presentation, and its requested PCB evidence belongs to the other duplicate-code identity.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly requires a complete six-member UI set, per-zone mapping, freshness and human review.
historical_reviews.history: The row-1876 duplicate is an IPMI TEMP_GB_PCB1~4 case and must remain isolated from this BMC-Web VR-zone variant.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Zone numbering must be tied to named voltage-regulator domains or board locations. Six visible values can still be wrong if indices are swapped, duplicated or mapped to absent hardware, so completeness and one-to-one topology association are separate acceptance checks.

original_test_intent: Verify that BMC Web exposes exactly the expected TEMP_VR_Zone1 through TEMP_VR_Zone6 entries and that every zone's physical regulator mapping, temperature, units, health, thresholds and freshness conform to the approved platform SPEC.
original_method: Load the verified Sensor List through protected Web access, capture route/filter/pagination/refresh state, enumerate each of the six zone rows individually, join their identities to the approved VR/board topology, compare all rendered fields and ranges to the SPEC, correlate supported raw data if needed, and retain the complete evidence without thermal or log mutation.
manual_activity: An authorized thermal/platform reviewer confirms all six Web rows, their regulator/board locations and SPEC comparisons, including page state and any platform-approved absent-zone rule; automation may collect and structure the evidence.
required_inputs: Per-zone units, health, thresholds and valid ranges
safety_requirements: Never change VR thresholds, fan policy, power or firmware
Resolve six names separately rather than a literal range
Verify page filters, pagination and refresh
Reject PCB-sensor evidence from the duplicate variant
Record missing, duplicate, swapped and stale zones
Do not infer topology from display order
agent_execution_scope: Verify target, Web route, SPEC and VR topology
Compare reading, units, health, thresholds, timestamp and range per zone
engineer_actions: Visually confirm rendered rows and page context
Resolve missing, swapped, duplicate or stale zones

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A single quoted range is not proof of six sensor queries, the truncated SDR output can hide members, and TEMP_GB_PCB1~4 is the wrong duplicate-code identity; ipmitool is at most a cross-check.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the protected BMC-Web Sensor List to enumerate and capture TEMP_VR_Zone1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 separately; compare each unique physical mapping and complete fields with the approved SPEC, with full backend reads only for corroboration.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The six-zone BMC-Web inspection and 3/3-minute source estimate remain; log clearing, range shorthand and PCB substitution are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a six-row matrix keyed by explicit zone name and physical regulator domain, attaching the UI member, value, unit, health, thresholds, timestamp, range result and raw evidence link.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Turns a generic visual check into a complete topology-aware set comparison while keeping the Web UI authoritative.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A subset of plausible temperatures cannot reveal a missing zone, duplicated index, swapped regulator mapping, hidden page row or stale Web cache.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Platforms with fewer populated VR domains require an approved applicability map; absence cannot be accepted solely because hardware appears unpopulated.

project_override_considerations: The Project must state whether all six zones are mandatory for this SKU and map each to its regulator/board domain. The later TEMP_GB_PCB1~4 duplicate code has independent identity and evidence and cannot substitute for any VR zone.
expected_evidence: Target/firmware/Web route, VR SPEC revision and physical six-zone topology
Protected browser/session metadata with secrets redacted
Complete UI capture of Zone1 through Zone6 plus filter/pagination/refresh context
Per-zone unique mapping, reading, unit, health, thresholds, timestamp and range result
Approved backend reconciliation and explicit missing/duplicate/swapped/stale findings

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Web procedure and SPEC criterion coherently target six VR temperature zones. The generic clear and DeepSeek's PCB evidence are method/reference defects, not alternative Master coverage.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The six-zone topology, SPEC and protected UI are identifiable inputs. Execution becomes BLOCKED if expected zones or their physical mapping cannot be resolved unambiguously after the normal package request.

review_improvement: Defines a six-element, one-to-one VR topology oracle and prevents literal-range queries or duplicate-code PCB evidence from masking missing zones.
independent_technical_reasoning: This case tests a labeled set, not a single temperature. Set cardinality, unique names and physical mappings must first agree; only then can each value's unit, health, threshold and freshness be evaluated. A reasonable numeric reading cannot compensate for a missing or misassigned regulator domain.
